title: Experienced Life and Annuity Actuary - Remote

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Experienced Life and Annuity Actuary to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management. Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements. Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations. Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc. Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas. Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders. Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership. Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals. Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends. Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Preferred Requirements
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.
cond_0001.encouragement_text:
Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0028.responsibilities: Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management. Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements. Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations. Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc. Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas. Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders. Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership. Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals. Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends. Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0028.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7

cond_0083.responsibilities: Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management. Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements. Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations. Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc. Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas. Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders. Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership. Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals. Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends. Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0083.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Alternatively, 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Minimum 12 years of demonstrated actuarial expertise with attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR extensive relevant actuarial experience of 12 years with attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Established Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Proven track record leading project teams on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated expertise preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Strong command of Python or R.
Substantial expertise in reinsurance transactions.
Advanced knowledge of Deposit Asset Accounting.

Advanced knowledge of CECL.

cond_0123.intro: We are looking for an Experienced Life and Annuity Actuary to join our team. You will work on the Life Actuarial Valuation team within [Company name masked]'s Chief Financial Office, regularly collaborating with colleagues to develop models, calculators, tools, processes, and controls for Deposit Asset Accounting, Life Reinsurance Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL), and Risk Based Capital (RBC).
cond_0123.responsibilities:
Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and actively raises recommendations for improvements in discussions with the team.
Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations and keeps the team informed.
Shares knowledge with team members daily and serves as a key resource to the entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues — initiating contact to navigate obstacles and deliver work product.
Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc., and regularly fields questions from colleagues and leadership.
Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas, bringing people together to align on direction at each phase.
Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals and findings, and walks stakeholders through the information in an understandable and usable format.
Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, regularly presenting recommendations to leadership.
Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals.
Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggests timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends.
Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0123.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R.
Experience with reinsurance transactions.
Deposit Asset Accounting experience.
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code.
Experience with projecting RBC.
Experience with CECL.
Experience with FRB SR 11-7.

You will drive the development of models, calculators, tools, processes, and controls for Deposit Asset Accounting, Life Reinsurance Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL), and Risk Based Capital (RBC).
cond_0314.responsibilities:
Executes complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
Leads review of laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and delivers recommendations for improvements.
Directs monitoring of industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations.
Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to the entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues, navigating obstacles to deliver work product.
Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Develops exhibits and reports that explain proposals/findings and delivers information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders.
Independently identifies business problems and drives recommended solutions, often presenting directly to leadership.
Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals.
Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and drives timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends.
Determines the impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0314.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Preferred Requirements
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7

Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements. Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations. Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc. Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas. Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders. Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership. Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals. Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends. Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0353.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Alternatively, 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Minimum 12 years of demonstrated actuarial expertise with attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR extensive relevant actuarial experience of 12 years with attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Established Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Proven track record leading project teams on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated expertise preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Strong command of Python or R.
Substantial expertise in reinsurance transactions.
Advanced knowledge of Deposit Asset Accounting.
Exceptional ability to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code.
Deep knowledge of projecting RBC.
Advanced knowledge of CECL.
Advanced knowledge of FRB SR 11-7.
cond_0353.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with actuarial modeling and the technical demands of life and annuity work.
cond_0401.responsibilities:
Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements.
Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations.
Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product.
Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders.
Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership.
Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals.
Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends.
Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0401.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Preferred Requirements
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.
cond_0401.encouragement_text:
Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0401.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

cond_0422.intro: As an Experienced Life and Annuity Actuary, you will own your work on the Life Actuarial Valuation team within [Company name masked]'s Chief Financial Office. You will drive the development of models, calculators, tools, processes, and controls for Deposit Asset Accounting, Life Reinsurance Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL), and Risk Based Capital (RBC).
cond_0422.responsibilities:
Executes complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
Leads review of laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and delivers recommendations for improvements.
Directs monitoring of industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations.
Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to the entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues, navigating obstacles to deliver work product.
Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Develops exhibits and reports that explain proposals/findings and delivers information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders.
Independently identifies business problems and drives recommended solutions, often presenting directly to leadership.
Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals.
Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and drives timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends.
Determines the impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0422.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Preferred Requirements
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

cond_0442.responsibilities: Performs complex and often unique work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management. Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant and provides recommendations for improvements. Monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations. Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a key resource to entire team, including leadership, on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Serves as a Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc. Leads a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas. Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders. Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership. Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals. Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends. Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0442.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
6 Years actuarial experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 12 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
Subject Matter Expert in one or more key areas, such as Product Pricing, Reserving, Economic Capital, Modeling, Asset Liability Management, etc.
Experience leading a project team on complex assignments through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases involving cross functional actuarial areas.
Demonstrated experience preparing effective documentation, facilitating training and development, and presenting to various levels of management.
Proficient in Python or R
Experience with reinsurance transactions
Deposit Asset Accounting experience
Able to translate actuarial and accounting concepts into proficient and portable code
Experience with projecting RBC
Experience with CECL
Experience with FRB SR 11-7
cond_0442.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
